name: dnd-campaign-manager
description: A campaign manager for D&D 5e: character sheets, live sessions and a real-time combat tracker.
author: Oleg (0x5450L)

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,green,cyan "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
